title: Replace the project proxy wrapper with Qt's QML SortFilterProxyModel
scope: Backlog intake only. Migration and removal of the project wrapper remain deferred until selected.
request: Use Qt's SortFilterProxyModel exposed to QML instead of the project's custom C++ SortFilterProxyModel.
expected: The drawer list catalog uses Qt's QML proxy type with explicit sort/filter configuration. The redundant project wrapper and its build/QML registration are removed without changing list selection or shopping behavior.
current_evidence: View.qml creates the project SortFilterProxyModel over a read-only Model and uses it for the Lists selector, with name as textRole and id as valueRole.
sortfilterproxymodel.cpp configures Qt::CheckStateRole filtering with ^false$ and ascending column-0 sorting; its remaining parser-status hook is empty.
CMakeLists.txt compiles sortfilterproxymodel.h/.cpp into the QShopper QML module.

Qt documentation checked on 2026-11-01 exposes SortFilterProxyModel through QtQml.Models since Qt 6.10. The current Qt 6.12 documentation labels the API technology preview. No application defect is claimed.
implementation_notes: Inspect the API in the supported Qt kits and use QtQml.Models sorters/filters to express the existing behavior directly; follow KISS and avoid another wrapper or generic filtering framework.

Preserve filtering of checked catalog entries and name sorting, including case, locale, equal-name ordering and the synthetic catalog entry. Establish the original behavior before choosing equivalent role/value and sorter settings.
Preserve active-list UUID binding, fresh-install default display, catalog reload on drawer opening, create/rename/delete/Undo and selection restoration after restart.
Keep this scoped to the drawer catalog proxy; preserve the user's shopping order, checked-item stack and Reset behavior.
Resolve the identical Qt/project type names explicitly during migration. Remove the obsolete C++ files, QML registration and CMake source references once the replacement is wired in.
Verify module import/deployment on Windows and Android and account for the documented preview status when recording supported versions. Coordinate only necessary build edits with DEV-004.
acceptance_criteria: Use Qt's QML SortFilterProxyModel for the drawer catalog and remove the project wrapper and stale build/QML references.
Add or strengthen automated characterization of filtering, sorting and dynamic catalog changes before migration; the same observable behavior must pass with the replacement.
Existing fresh/default selection, UUID, catalog edit/Undo and restart tests pass, with shopping contents/order and unfinished edits preserved.
Run tools/verify-windows.ps1 and appropriate native Android selector/catalog/deployment checks with isolated data.
Document the chosen Qt API/version and any material behavior differences; keep unrelated refactoring and app fixes separate.
evidence: User backlog request on 2026-11-01 to replace the project's proxy with the Qt QML-exposed type.
